newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar loses fund-led momentum, ends at lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar loses fund-led momentum, ends at lows.

text.p: LIFFE sugar finished at its lows on Thursday after an early bout of fund buying dried up and the market followed New York lower, traders said.
Front month October ended $1.80 lower at $321.00, and December settled $0.40 softer at $318.50.
Total volume was 3,468 lots, dominated by October.
Earlier October had hit a high of $324.50 on fund buying, but lack of follow through left prices to fall in the afternoon, a trader said.
"It's not out of line with New York. It just got a bit overbought and it's come back into line," said another.
In Paris, October was down $0.50 at $321.00.
